description: Integrated development of SC-majority villages.
Eligible: Villages with >50% SC population.
Provides infrastructure development (roads, water, sanitation, education, health).
documents_required: Proof of residence in SC-majority village

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
description: Development scheme for SC communities.
Eligible: SC communities, priority to aspirational districts.
Provides infrastructure, skill training, livelihood support.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Social Welfare Office

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free foodgrain distribution to BPL families.
Eligible: BPL families with ration cards.
Provides 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month.
channel_partner_name: Fair Price Shop (PDS) + Gram Panchayat Office
maximum_benefit: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month

description: Subsidized foodgrain through PDS.
Eligible: BPL and AAY families with ration cards.
Provides rice at ₹3/kg, wheat at ₹2/kg.
channel_partner_name: Fair Price Shop (PDS) + Gram Panchayat Office

description: Rural road connectivity scheme.
Eligible: Unconnected habitations with population >100 (plain) or >50 (hilly/tribal).
Provides all-weather road connectivity.
documents_required: Proof of residence in unconnected habitation
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Rural Development Agency

description: Irrigation scheme for farmers.
Eligible: Farmers with cultivable land.
Provides micro-irrigation, drip/sprinkler systems with 55–75% subsidy.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Agriculture Office

description: Scheme for fisheries sector development.
Eligible: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, women, SC/ST.
Provides financial assistance with 40–60% subsidy.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Financial assistance up to ₹10–20 lakh with 40–60% subsidy

description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
Eligible: Small/marginal farmers (up to 2 hectares), age 18–40 years.
Provides ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maandhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme for small traders and shopkeepers.
Eligible: Small traders/shopkeepers, age 18–40 years, turnover below ₹1.5 crore.
Provides ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60.
Pension scheme for senior citizens.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 60+ years.
Provides assured return of 7.4% per annum, payable monthly for 10 years.
maximum_benefit: Assured return of 7.4% per annum on investment up to ₹15 lakh

description: Savings scheme for senior citizens with attractive interest rate.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 60+ years (55+ for retired defence).
Provides quarterly interest at ~8.2% p.a.
maximum_benefit: Quarterly interest at ~8.2% p.a. on investment up to ₹30 lakh

description: Free comprehensive antenatal care for pregnant women.
Eligible: All pregnant women, especially from poor sections.
Provides free check-ups, tests, consultations on 9th of every month.
documents_required: Mother and Child Protection Card (MCP Card)

description: Scheme for establishing AIIMS-like institutions and upgrading medical colleges.
Eligible: Patients seeking tertiary healthcare.
Provides affordable quality healthcare.
Free dialysis services for poor patients.
Eligible: BPL patients with kidney failure.
Provides free dialysis sessions at empanelled hospitals.
documents_required: BPL ration card or income certificate

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) - Ayushman Bharat
description: Health insurance scheme providing coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
Eligible: BPL families and specific occupational categories (SECC 2011).
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all family members
maximum_benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year

description: Early childhood care and development programme.
Eligible: Children (0–6 years), pregnant women, lactating mothers.
Provides supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, health check-ups.
maximum_benefit: Free supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, health services

description: Free cooked meals for school children.
Eligible: Children studying in Class 1–8 in government/government-aided schools.
Provides nutritious meal on all working days.
maximum_benefit: Free nutritious meal on all school working days

scheme_name: National Health Mission (NHM) - ASHA Worker Programme
description: Community health worker programme for rural and urban areas.
Eligible: Women, age 25–45 years, minimum Class 10 pass.
Provides honorarium and performance-based incentives.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Health Office

description: Free LPG connection for BPL households.
Eligible: Adult woman from BPL household, no existing LPG connection.
Provides deposit-free LPG connection with subsidy.
documents_required: BPL ration card or SECC proof
maximum_benefit: Free LPG connection (worth ₹3,200) + ongoing LPG subsidy

description: Crop insurance scheme for farmers.
Eligible: All farmers growing notified crops.
Provides insurance cover against crop loss due to natural calamities.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Insurance cover up to sum insured (varies by crop)

description: Income support scheme for farmer families.
Eligible: Farmer families with cultivable land, no income bar.
Provides ₹6,000 per year in three instalments.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all family members

description: Credit facility for farmers for cultivation and agricultural needs.
Eligible: All farmers (individual/joint), including tenant farmers.
Provides credit limit based on landholding.
npa_percentage: Approx. 5.3% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Regional Rural Banks)
maximum_benefit: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh (varies by landholding)

description: Online trading platform for agricultural produce.
Eligible: Farmers, traders, buyers registered in APMC markets.
Provides transparent price discovery and online trading.
maximum_benefit: Better price realization through transparent online trading

description: Scheme for holistic development of agriculture and allied sectors.
Eligible: Farmers, farmer groups, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs.
Provides financial support for innovative projects.
channel_partner_name: District Agriculture Office + State Agriculture Department

description: Innovation and entrepreneurship programme for school students.
Eligible: Students from Class 6–12 in ATL schools.
Provides hands-on experience with robotics, 3D printing, IoT.
maximum_benefit: Free access to innovation lab, mentorship, prototyping facilities
